description: Land  Acquisition - Progression Tracing Nos. Maha/MHN/2012/353, Maha/MHN/2012/354 and Maha/MHN/2012/317 of Katugastota, Kandy Four Gravets & Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, containing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, assessment numbers, and extents for public purpose acquisition. It falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structures, or other specialized categories.
